Name: Acts 2-3 (draft)
Source: Act 2: order from the Maxroll PoE2 campaign guide (updated 2026-06-02). Act 3: drafted 2026-10-11 from the known campaign order and Radar's G3 places, fixed live with the player through the feedback key. Places are Radar targets.json names.

Quests.Label: Venom Crypts: search the corpse (Venom Vial)
Quests.Note: Verified live 2026-10-11: 9 = 'Search for the source of their poison' (town), 8 = 'Explore The Venom Crypts' (on entering), 7 = 'You have discovered a corpse. Search it.' (near it, vial not taken yet), 6 = 'Pick up the Corpse-snake Venom' (on the ground, Metadata/Items/QuestItems/Gallows/Act3/SnakeLadyPotion: the quest-item rule leads to it). The corpse is Metadata/Chests/QuestChests/SnakePit/SnakeLadyPotionChest in the boss room

Quests.Label: Enter Jiquani's Machinarium
Quests.Note: Verified live 2026-10-11: 49 = 'You have defeated the Machinarium's guardian chimera. Enter the facility.' Xyclucian drops the Chimeral Inscribed Ultimatum (Metadata/Items/QuestItems/UltimatumKeyQuest): the quest-item rule leads to it first

Quests.Label: Xyclucian, the Chimera (Deadly Nest)
Quests.Note: Verified live 2026-10-11: 50 = 'A massive beast seems to be guarding the entrance to the Machinarium. Defeat it.' (set in the Chimeral Wetlands)

Quests.Label: Place the Soul Core in the Stone Altar
Quests.Note: Verified live 2026-10-11: 44 = 'You have found a small Soul Core. Take it to the Stone Altar to proceed deeper into the ruin.' Cores are ground items Metadata/Items/QuestItems/Gallows/Act3/VaalKeyGem (the quest-item rule leads to them); altars are 3_6_1/Objects/KeyPedestal_Entrance|Exit|Boss|Landmark, each next to a KeyDoor

Quests.Label: Explore for the next Soul Core
Quests.Note: Verified live 2026-10-11: 48 = 'found an ancient Vaal facility, search for a large Soul Core' (on entering), 47/46 = stone altar / ask Alva (the user skips Alva), 43 = 'found a small Soul Core and opened the door ... proceed deeper'. The area steps explore toward the Sanctum; each core takes over when it loads

Quests.Label: Infested Barrens: on to the Chimeral Wetlands
Quests.Note: Verified live 2026-10-11: 56 = 'Find The Matlan Waterways' (town); 55 = 'discovered a stone altar ... control mechanism for a canal; summon Alva' (Jungle Ruins). The waterways stay flooded until Jiquani's Sanctum, so the Barrens steps go to the Chimeral Wetlands first

Quests.Label: Light the Ancient Seals (3), then the Clasped Entry
Quests.Note: Verified live 2026-10-10: state 6 = 'Enter the Titan Grotto at the Clasped Entry' (the G2_6 steps handle the seals and the entry)

Quests.Label: Pick up the Essence of Water
Quests.Note: Verified live 2026-10-10: state 3 = 'Pick up the Essence of Water'; it drops by the goddess (~(2752,832)) as a WorldItem whose item is Metadata/Items/QuestItems/Gallows/Act2/EssenceOfTheWaterGod

Quests.Label: Wait while the Water Goddess burns
Quests.Note: Unverified (2026-10-10, from the user): between using the cinders (5) and the essence (3) you wait for her to die; the route stays on her instead of the island fallback

Quests.Label: Use the Everburning Cinders on the Water Goddess
Quests.Note: Verified live 2026-10-10: state 5 = 'Use the nearby Everburning Cinders to grant her request'. WaterGoddess_Fire ('Everburning Cinders', ~(2737,874)) is clickable first; WaterGoddess_BurnInteract ('Ignite the Goddess', ~(2737,820)) is untargetable until then

Quests.Label: Speak with the Water Goddess
Quests.Note: Verified live 2026-10-10: state 6 = 'There is a Water Goddess lying in a shrine at the heart of Keth'; after the Heart of Keth boss, WaterGoddessUnnamed stands south of the arena (~(2737,818)) past the BossDoor; the Heart of Keth (boss transition) is the fallback until she is loaded

Quests.Label: Search for access to Keth
Quests.Note: Verified live 2026-10-10: state 10 = 'Search for access to Keth'

Quests.Label: Retrace Orbala's path: the Horn of the Vastiri (Mastodon Badlands)
Quests.Note: Verified live 2026-10-10: state 18 = 'only recreating the Horn of the Vastiri will dispel the sandstorm'. Listed before the caravan return: the user does the horn first, then talks to Zarka. Area steps lead on to the Bone Pits

Quests.Label: Return to the Ardura Caravan
Quests.Note: Verified live 2026-10-10: state 2 = 'You have burned the Water Goddess alive at her request. Return to the Ardura Caravan.' (set when the Essence of Water is picked up)

G3_2_1.Label: Side quest: The Azak Bog (Ignagduk, +30 Spirit)

G3_6_1.Label: Place the Soul Core in the Stone Altar
G3_6_1.Note: Verified live 2026-10-11: cores are VaalKeyGem<n> in MainInventory once picked up; the quest stays at 43 while you carry the second one, so the inventory decides. Used altars turn untargetable (KeyPedestal_Entrance)

G3_6_1.Label: Keep exploring: the next Soul Core shows when it loads

G3_12.Label: Up the Temple of Kopec: Ketzuli at the top

G2_6.Label: Take the seal's portal
G2_6.Note: Verified live 2026-10-10: clicking TitanValley_SwitchN (up the stairs) makes AncientSealNPortal targetable with active=1, ~90 cells from the switch on the same TitanQuest tile (a seal platform is ~185 cells wide, so no Within); the portal returns you to the valley

G2_6.Label: Light the Ancient Seal (click it, up the stairs)
G2_6.Note: The seal itself: Metadata/QuestObjects/Four_Act2/TitanValley_SwitchN, IngameIcon 'Ancient Seal'; active=1 and untargetable once lit. Loaded only near the platform, so the tile step below leads you there first

G2_6.Label: Go to the next Ancient Seal
G2_6.Note: Radar's TitanQuest01/02/03.tdt platforms; one whose switch was seen lit (loaded now or earlier this visit) is dropped. A platform never visited counts as unlit. All three seal steps end once AncientSeal1/2/3Portal have all been seen active=1 (2026-10-10: the switches were never seen lit, so ExcludeNear alone kept sending you to a lit seal)

G2_6.Label: The Titan Grotto (Clasped Entry): walk up, it animates open, go in
G2_6.Note: Verified live 2026-10-10: the G2_7 transition is AreaTransition_Animate in the valley centre (CentreTile_Larger.tdt, ~(680,1016)), next to TitanValley_TitanHands; the old titan_valley_boss_01 tile guess was wrong
